caption: the Dash formula on a farm: cows to milk, eggs to gather, crops to water - one clock over all of it.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: no official channel survives. playfirst folded into glu mobile in 2014, playfirst.com is dead, and the portals that carried the dash line closed with it. the pc build has nowhere legal left to be sold.
links.anyway_note: this is the un-buyable case: no store, no key server, no publisher counter. the archive route is the only route.

about: Dairy Dash, released for windows on 23 may 2008, takes the chained-service loop out of the diner and onto a farm. Animals queue instead of customers: cows need milking, chickens need feeding, fields need watering, and every chore competes for the same two hands.

The farm setting trades the seating chart for a chore chart, but the underlying design - overlapping tasks, patience curves, chain bonuses - is the diner engine wearing overalls. It shipped through playfirst's channel in the side line's 2008 wave.
No official channel survives the publisher's collapse into glu mobile, so the 2008 build is an un-buyable archive case.
